items.question: Where is Yueli Automation based?
items.answer: Yueli Automation is based in Quanzhou, Fujian, China. Contact our team to discuss equipment selection, a custom automation project or technical support.

items.question: How do I choose suitable equipment?
items.answer: Start with a workpiece drawing or sample photo. Include the material, key dimensions, required process, tolerance and target output so our team can review the application.

items.question: Can the equipment be customized?
items.answer: Share your workpiece and production requirements. The equipment configuration and scope of any custom work are confirmed after technical review.

items.question: Can I provide a sample workpiece?
items.answer: Discuss the workpiece and testing requirements with our team first. Any sample machining, handling or acceptance arrangements are confirmed for the project.

items.question: What information is needed for a quote?
items.answer: Provide a workpiece drawing or photo, material, key dimensions, required process and tolerance, target output and destination country.

items.question: How are delivery arrangements confirmed?
items.answer: Packing, shipment, destination requirements and delivery timing are discussed against the confirmed equipment scope and order.
